metadata.overview: Reports Ocean.xyz mining pool account data (hashrate, workers, balances, revenue) and, when configured, the local DATUM gateway status. Read-only: pool and gateway state are polled over HTTP(S), no device writes.

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Total pool-side hashrate across configured accounts (60s window). 0 before the first 1-minute stats cycle has run.

telemetry.name: workers_online
telemetry.description: Workers with non-zero 600s hashrate across configured accounts; idle workers are excluded. 0 before the first 5-minute workers cycle has run.

telemetry.name: balance
telemetry.description: Unpaid earnings (Ocean statsnap `unpaid`) across configured accounts.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Estimated earnings if the pool finds the next block (Ocean statsnap `estimated_total_earn_next_block`) across configured accounts.

troubleshooting: If Ocean_pool_not_reachable, verify config/ocean.json apiUrl and outbound HTTPS connectivity to the Ocean API.
If Datum_Offline, verify the DATUM gateway process is running and config/ocean.json datum.apiUrl points at its API port.

errors.ERR_POOL_REQUIRED: The plugin was connected without the MiningOS worker instance; an internal wiring failure in plugin/boot.js.
errors.ERR_QUERY_INVALID: An ext_data request carried no query.
errors.ERR_KEY_INVALID: An ext_data query carried no key.
errors.ERR_START_INVALID: A history ext_data query (stats-history, transactions, blocks, workers-count, alerts-history) is missing start.
errors.ERR_END_INVALID: A history ext_data query is missing end.
